scope: The one car Qazi asked about · Irvine, CA
title: What This Car Has Been Through
lead: One 2024 750S Spider at McLaren Newport Beach. Full CARFAX and the window sticker read line by line; priced against 4 BaT sales and 5 live dealer asks.
takeaway: My two cents: clean, local, one-owner car at a full price. Fair is $338k to $342k. Open at $335k, land $340k, walk above $345k. Philadelphia's 6k-mile Spider asks $354,309 and has sat since Sep 18; use it. This one saves about $2,000 in transport. Make the missed annual service theirs before delivery.
shift: Lamborghini Philadelphia 6k $354,309 (listed Sep 18) and 10k $364,310; Brooklyn Auto 6k $359,999; Ferrari of Charlotte 12k $359,995; Velocity Nashville 8k $364,995 (classic.com, Nov 15)
No service record since 701 mi in Jan 2025, about 21 months. Warranty about 14 months left. Extend it before it lapses: the lapsed 720S needed a $1,480 inspection plus $10,530 for a year
sources: Dealer listing and its free CARFAX (ar20 link) read in full in Walt Chrome, Nov 15, 2026. Window sticker from the dealer's iPacket Original MSRP module (PDF dated Oct 14, 2026). Days listed from the CARFAX 'offered for sale' date, Nov 5. Sold prices from Bring a Trailer; live asks from classic.com, Nov 15. Reviews: Google (all 102, newest first), Yelp, DealerRater, Cars.com, BBB. Staff titles from mclarennb.com About Us. Nobody contacted.

Owner 1, personal lease, San Clemente, CA. Titled with a lien
Two dealer visits: alignment and tire checks at 340 and 701 mi
No service for about 21 months, 701 to 6,914 mi. First annual service (due late 2025) not on the report
Lease turned in; listed at $354,966, 6,914 mi. Original MSRP $398,240. Factory warranty about 14 months left (to about Jan 2028)
cars.verdict: $9,966 over the $345k cap at $354,966. Open $335k, target $340k, walk above $345k. The cleanest kind of 750S: one owner, no accidents, local Irvine car, $53k of options, 14 months of factory warranty. The one knock: no service on record since 701 mi. Before money, ask for their repair orders, and make the missed annual service part of the deal, done and documented before delivery.
